# PERFORMANCE MARKETING & ANALYTICS PLAYBOOK: PROD_UNSEEN_AI_SPEAK_VN
**Position:** Performance Marketing & Analytics Specialist  
**Target Market:** Vietnam (Digital Distribution)  
**Product:** PROD_UNSEEN_AI_SPEAK_VN (AI-Powered English Conversation Partner)  
**Document Version:** v1.0 (Stage 5 Performance & Analytics Framework)

---

## 1. Full-Funnel Measurement Framework

To validate our strategic positioning of **PROD_UNSEEN_AI_SPEAK_VN** as a low-pressure, judgment-free sandbox, our measurement framework must track both standard acquisition metrics and deep in-app behavioral events. This ensures we optimize for high-intent users who build a daily practice habit, rather than cheap, non-active installs.

```
[ Impression / Click ] ──> [ Install / Land ] ──> [ First 15-Min Session ] ──> [ Transcript View ] ──> [ Day 7+ Habit ]
      (CAC / CTR)               (CPI / CVR)            (Activation Rate)         (Value Realization)       (Retention)
```

### Funnel Metrics Matrix

| Funnel Stage | Metric Name | Definition / Formula | Data Source | Target Benchmark (VN Market) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Acquisition** | **CTR (Click-Through Rate)** | `(Clicks / Impressions) * 100` | Meta Ads / TikTok Ads | > 1.8% (Sandbox creative) |
| **Acquisition** | **CPI (Cost Per Install)** | `Total Ad Spend / Total Installs` | MMP (AppsFlyer/Adjust) | $0.40 - $0.80 USD |
| **Acquisition** | **CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)** | `Total Ad Spend / New Paid Subscribers` | MMP + Internal DB | $12.00 - $15.00 USD |
| **Activation** | **First-Mile Activation Rate** | `(Users completing 1st 15-min session / Installs) * 100` | Amplitude / Mixpanel | > 65% |
| **Activation** | **Transcript Engagement Rate** | `(Users viewing post-session transcript / Installs) * 100` | Amplitude / Mixpanel | > 80% of active users |
| **Retention** | **Day 1 Retention (D1)** | `(Active Users on Day 1 / Cohort Size) * 100` | MMP / Amplitude | > 40% |
| **Retention** | **Day 7 Retention (D7)** | `(Active Users on Day 7 / Cohort Size) * 100` | MMP / Amplitude | > 18% |
| **Retention** | **Habit Formation Index (HFI)** | `Users completing ≥ 4 daily 15-min sessions in Week 1` | Internal DB | > 25% of activated users |
| **Monetization** | **Trial-to-Paid Conversion** | `(Paid Subscribers / Trial Starters) * 100` | App Store Connect / GP Console | > 35% |
| **Monetization** | **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** | `(Subscription Revenue / Ad Spend) * 100` | MMP / Ad Networks | > 120% (Day 30) |

### Guardrail Metrics (System Health & Quality Control)
*   **Unsubscribe / Refund Rate (7-Day):** Must remain **< 3%**. High refunds indicate a mismatch between creative expectations (e.g., expecting live human tutors) and product reality (AI-powered self-directed practice).
*   **App Store Rating Drop:** Alert triggers if the rolling 7-day average rating drops below **4.2 stars**.
*   **Cost Per Activated User (CPAU):** `Total Ad Spend / Users completing their first 15-minute session`. If CPAU exceeds **$2.50 USD**, ad delivery optimization must pivot from "Install" to "In-App Event Optimization" (AEO).

---

## 2. Attribution & Tracking Architecture

To navigate the privacy-first landscape (iOS App Tracking Transparency, Android Privacy Sandbox, and cookie deprecation), we will deploy a hybrid attribution model combining a Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) with a robust Web-to-App funnel.

```
                                  +---------------------------------------+
                                  |         TRAFFIC SOURCES (VN)          |
                                  |  Meta, TikTok, Google Search/YouTube  |
                                  +-------------------+-------------------+
                                                      |
                                     [User Clicks Ad with UTMs]
                                                      |
                                                      v
                                  +-------------------+-------------------+
                                  |        WEB LANDING PAGE (GA4)         |
                                  |   Pre-qualifies user on "Sợ Sai"      |
                                  +-------------------+-------------------+
                                                      |
                                            [App Store Redirect]
                                                      |
                                                      v
                                  +-------------------+-------------------+
                                  |       MMP SDK (AppsFlyer/Adjust)      |
                                  |  De-duplicates & attributes install   |
                                  +-------------------+-------------------+
                                                      |
                                                      v
                                  +-------------------+-------------------+
                                  |       PRODUCT ANALYTICS ENGINE        |
                                  |   Tracks: 15-min practice, transcript  |
                                  +---------------------------------------+
```

### 1. MMP Setup & Event Mapping
We will integrate a tier-1 MMP (AppsFlyer or Adjust) to act as our single source of truth. The SDK will map the following custom schema:

```json
{
  "events": [
    {
      "mmp_event_name": "af_complete_registration",
      "internal_trigger": "User creates account",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "mmp_event_name": "af_start_15m_practice",
      "internal_trigger": "User initiates a 15-minute daily practice session",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "mmp_event_name": "af_complete_15m_practice",
      "internal_trigger": "User completes a full 15-minute session",
      "priority": "Critical"
    },
    {
      "mmp_event_name": "af_view_transcript",
      "internal_trigger": "User opens the generated post-session transcript",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "mmp_event_name": "af_start_trial",
      "internal_trigger": "User initiates subscription trial",
      "priority": "Critical"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 2. iOS Attribution Strategy (SKAdNetwork 4.0)
Given Vietnam's high iOS market share among middle-to-high-income learners, we must optimize our SKAN conversion value schema:
*   **Fine Conversion Value (0-63) - First 24-48 Hours:**
    *   `CV 1-10`: Completed registration.
    *   `CV 11-30`: Completed first 15-minute daily practice session.
    *   `CV 31-50`: Viewed post-session transcript.
    *   `CV 51-63`: Started free trial.
*   **Coarse Conversion Values (Low, Medium, High):**
    *   `Low`: Completed registration.
    *   `Medium`: Completed first 15-minute practice session.
    *   `High`: Started free trial.

### 3. Web-to-App Funnel Tracking
Because mobile web traffic in Vietnam (via Facebook Mobile Browser and TikTok In-App Browser) is highly cost-effective, we will run a Web-to-App funnel:
1.  **Ad Destination:** High-speed mobile landing page hosted locally (e.g., via Cloudflare CDN in Hanoi/HCM City).
2.  **Tracking Pixels:** Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) loaded via Google Tag Manager.
3.  **Deep Linking:** The "Download App" call-to-action on the landing page will use MMP Smart Links (e.g., AppsFlyer OneLink) to pass UTM parameters through the App Store/Google Play Store, ensuring 100% attribution down to the specific creative asset.

### 4. UTM Taxonomy Standard
All campaigns must strictly adhere to the following naming convention to isolate performance by creative territory:
`[Country]_[Channel]_[Objective]_[Targeting]_[Territory]_[CreativeFormat]`
*   *Example:* `VN_Meta_Conversion_LAL-Lookalike_Sandbox-Territory1_Video-1x1`

---

## 3. Structured Experiment Portfolio

To systematically validate our positioning and product features, we will execute three concurrent, isolated A/B tests.

*   **Methodology:** Split-testing on Meta Ads using a 50/50 budget split via Meta Experiments (to prevent audience overlap).
